metadata.question: On July 7, was the year-to-date rainfall in the coastal city of La Serena lower than the 1990-2020 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need rainfall data for La Serena (coastal city in Chile, approximately -29.9°, -71.3°) - Compare two periods: * Year-to-date 2024 (Jan 1 - July 7, 2024) * Historical average for same period (Jan 1 - July 7) across years 1990-2020 - Use CHIRPS precipitation dataset (daily, good for rainfall analysis) 2. Masking strategy: - Precipitation data from CHIRPS doesn't need cloud masking - Just sum the daily precipitation values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid zero: It's possible La Serena had very low rainfall (it's in a semi-arid region) - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If after processing, no valid pixels (unlikely for CHIRPS which has global coverage) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A/B: Compare the two values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laSerena = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.3, -29.9]); // Year-to-date 2024 (Jan 1 - July 7, 2024) const ytd2024Start = '2024-01-01'; const ytd2024End = '2024-07-07'; // Historical period: Same days (Jan 1 - July 7) for years 1990-2020 const historicalYears = ee.List.sequence(1990, 2020); // 2. Data Acquisition for 2024 YTD const chirps2024 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(ytd2024Start, ytd2024End) .filterBounds(laSerena); const count2024 = chirps2024.size().getInfo(); console.log('2024 YTD Images:', count2024); if (count2024 === 0) { console.log('No data for 2024 YTD period.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate 2024 YTD rainfall const rainfall2024 = chirps2024.select('precipitation').sum(); const stats2024 = rainfall2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const ytdRainfall2024 = stats2024.precipitation; if (ytdRainfall2024 === null || ytdRainfall2024 === undefined) { console.log('Failed to calculate 2024 YTD rainfall.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log('2024 YTD Rainfall (mm):', ytdRainfall2024.toFixed(2)); // 4. Calculate historical average (1990-2020) for same period const historicalRainfall = historicalYears.map(function(year) { const yearInt = ee.Number(year).toInt(); const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(yearInt, 1, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(yearInt, 7, 7); const yearlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(laSerena); const yearlySum = yearlyCol.select('precipitation').sum(); return yearlySum.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); }); const historicalList = historicalRainfall.getInfo(); const validHistorical = historicalList.filter(val => val !== null && val !== undefined); if (validHistorical.length === 0) { console.log('No valid historical data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } const historicalAvg = validHistorical.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / validHistorical.length; console.log('Historical Years with Data:', validHistorical.length); console.log('Historical Avg Rainfall (mm):', historicalAvg.toFixed(2)); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (isNaN(historicalAvg) || historicalAvg < 0) { console.log('Invalid historical average.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log('Comparison: 2024 YTD (' + ytdRainfall2024.toFixed(2) + ') vs Historical (' + historicalAvg.toFixed(2) + ')'); if (ytdRainfall2024 < historicalAvg) { console.log('2024 YTD rainfall is LOWER than historical average.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('2024 YTD rainfall is NOT lower than historical average.'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
